title: Pug Dog Tags for Snorts, Sheds & Wrinkles | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny pug dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Snorts, sheds and wrinkles covered. Saying on the front, name and phone number on the back. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for the breed that snorts like a pig, sheds like a snow globe and treats a hot summer like a personal insult. A pug's face is flat, but its opinions are not.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for wrinkles, humidity and face-first living
tough.html:
A pug lives with its face about two inches off the ground, and the tag goes everywhere that face goes: the water bowl, the grass, the couch cushion it's trying to dig to the center of.

Ours are laser engraved. The words are cut into the metal, not painted on top, so there's no ink to fade, smear or peel off.

Fine after the fifth beach trip. The pug, less so.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Flat faces, loud snores, strong feelings about food. We live with seven bulldogs, so pugs feel like cousins.

sayings.h2: 8 pug sayings written for the snort
sayings.lead: About the snorting, the shedding, the curly tail and the deep spiritual commitment to food. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

guides.text: Dog Tag Size Guide by Breed

items.q: Will humidity, pool water or drool ruin an engraved pug tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off.

items.q: Can I put my pug's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for pugs?
items.a: Eight on this page, covering snorting, shedding, wrinkles, the curly tail and food. Browse the full list or write your own in the builder.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
